scripts.fmt: pnpm --filter @devhub/app fmt:check && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge fmt:check && cargo fmt --all -- --check
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @devhub/app lint && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge lint && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @devhub/app test && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge test && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @devhub/app build && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge build && pnpm run app-shell:production-check && cargo build --workspace --locked
scripts.check: pnpm run bridge:check && pnpm run app-shell:check && pnpm run settings:check && pnpm run settings:capability-check && pnpm run terminal:check && pnpm run fmt && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && cargo check --workspace --locked
